hook.say: The ten largest islands on Earth, ranked. Number one is three times the size of Texas!

items.name: Ellesmere
items.say: Number ten: Elz-meer, Canada's northernmost island. 196,000 square kilometers.
items.cap: Number ten: Ellesmere, Canada's northernmost island. 196,000 square kilometers.
